text:
Lena (People Ops): Heads-up: we're publishing a short handbook update next Wed 09:00 PT covering the performance cycle timeline + mandatory manager calibration training. Changes: updated review windows, new calibration step, and required 20-min anti-bias micro-training for managers. Please flag blockers. :loudspeaker:

Marco (People Ops Ops): Are we changing any deadlines for ICs? Need to update the performance calendar.

Lena (People Ops): IC deadlines unchanged. New step is a mandatory manager calibration meeting (week after self-reviews). We'll add calendar blocks and a manager checklist.

Priya (HRIS): Will the HRIS need to enforce any fields or lock timelines? I can add a flag for "calibration_complete" and export a CSV.

Lena (People Ops): Yes please. We want counts by manager and region. Also we'll require managers to complete the 20-min micro-training in the LMS before calibration.

lms-bot: To enroll managers use: `/lms enroll --course "Manager Calibration & Unconscious Bias" --group managers --due 2026-05-10`. Completion exports: `/lms export --course-id 8742 --format csv --since 2026-04-01`.

Ahmed (Legal): Double-check wording around performance improvement plan (PIP) timelines so we don't change contractual obligations. I'll review the handbook copy by EOD.

Kelsey (Eng Manager): For large orgs, calibration meetings need a suggested facilitator flow and a 30-min prep deck. Can People Ops draft a template?

Lena (People Ops): We'll publish a facilitator guide + slide deck template in the manager TL;DR pack. Good call.

Priya (HRIS): For payroll/comp tagging we need a CSV header. Suggest this header and I'll wire it to the reporting pipeline:

```
# perf_export.csv header
manager_id,manager_name,team,region,num_reports,calibration_completed,calibration_ts,training_completed,training_ts,handbook_version,notes
```

Marco (People Ops Ops): Add `time_zone` column for meeting scheduling. Also add `manager_override` for late exceptions.

Lena (People Ops): Good. Action items: (1) publish handbook update Wed 09:00 PT, (2) LMS enrollment + micro-training live, (3) HRIS adds export fields and schedule, (4) Legal reviews copy by EOD, (5) People Ops drafts facilitator guide + manager TL;DR. Any objections?

Ahmed (Legal): No objections, will post comments by EOD.

Kelsey (Eng Manager): No objections, thanks for the prep materials.

lms-bot: Enrollment scheduled. Weekly training completion summary will post to #people-ops every Monday at 09:00 PT. :white_check_mark:

Lena (People Ops): Thanks team—I'll post the prod link and the manager TL;DR once live.
